name: fast-pdf-reader
description: Read PDFs smoothly, highlight requested changes, queue contextual comments and dictate locally in the optional Windows edition.

interface.shortDescription: Smooth local PDF reading and contextual comments
interface.longDescription: A local desktop PDF reader with continuous scrolling, crisp cached pages, independent text selection, search, bookmarks and a compact single-row toolbar. Select text or a region to open an inline Ask for change editor. Enter finishes a comment; Shift+Enter adds a line. Requested selections remain highlighted during the reader session, and comments can be collected as context before explicit batch handoff to the dialogue box. Supported host-opened files can notify you when a newer document version is available. Optional Windows x64 dictation uses a plugin-owned recorder and separately installed offline speech model, inserting the transcript into the same editor. Recording starts only after a microphone click and respects Windows permissions. Requires Node.js 22.13 or newer and a compatible desktop host. This package does not modify Codex application files.
defaultPrompt: Open Smooth PDF Reader so I can read a local PDF.
